newsitem.title: USA: Transsexual hooker with Eddie Murphy arrested.
newsitem.headline: Transsexual hooker with Eddie Murphy arrested.

text.p: Police stopped a vehicle driven by comedian Eddie Murphy early on Friday and arrested an alleged transsexual prostitute Murphy had picked up earlier, a sheriff's department spokesman said.
Deputy Mark Bailey said the suspect, Atisone Seiuli, 21, was arrested on an outstanding prostitution warrant but Murphy was not arrested.
"Mr. Murphy was apparently not involved in any criminal activity and was not detained," he said.
Bailey said Murphy, who is married, was seen by undercover officers picking up the suspect -- a known prostitute -- on Santa Monica Boulevard at 4:45 a.m. PDT (1145 GMT).
The deputies followed Murphy's Land Cruiser for two or three blocks and then stopped it.
Seiuli, described by Bailey as a transsexual, was taken into custody, the deputy sheriff said.
The suspect was booked at the West Hollywood sheriff's station and was being held on $15,000 bail.

There was no immediate comment from the actor's agent or publicist or from Murphy, who has starred in several movies including "Beverly Hills Cop", "The Golden Child", "Coming to America" and "The Nutty Professor".
